facts.text: The environment is registered as carla-rl-gym-v0 with entry point src.env.environment:CarlaEnv and max_episode_steps config.ENV_MAX_STEPS
The default constructor starts with continuous actions, a 60-second time limit and server initialization on
The continuous action space is a two-element Box from -1.0 to 1.0: steering and throttle/brake
The discrete action space is Discrete(4): accelerate, decelerate, turn left, turn right
The observation declares the RGB image as 360 x 640 x 3 and the LiDAR array as 3 x 500
The observation also carries position, target position, next waypoint position, speed and a situation index
The situation map maps Road to 0, Roundabout to 1, Junction to 2 and Tunnel to 3
The simulator connects to a CARLA server at localhost:2000 with a 100 s timeout
The world applies its synchronous flag to the CARLA settings and, when synchronous, fixes the delta to 1.0 / SIM_FPS seconds
ENV_MAX_STEPS is 430, the maximum number of steps per episode
reset returns the initial observation and an info dict with the scenario name and the waypoints
step ticks the world in synchronous mode, applies the vehicle control and returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated and info

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial position, heading and target of this package's fake and its step rule is deterministic, so one seed and action sequence repeat a trajectory; the upstream environment draws with numpy and the random module and runs the CARLA engine, so a seed does not reproduce the same trajectory as CARLA

gaps: kinematic stand-in only: positions change by an analytic rule with no vehicle dynamics, contacts, friction, sensors or noise model, so this is F0 and not the CARLA engine

the fake returns a 4 x 4 x 3 RGB image and a 3 x 4 LiDAR array instead of the upstream 360 x 640 x 3 and 3 x 500 arrays; the observation keys, ranks and dtypes match, but the values are Python numbers, not numpy arrays, and the real sizes are declared in src/env/observation_action_space.py:6-7
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and the fake truncates on a step count instead of the upstream 60-second wall-clock time limit
traffic, pedestrians, weather, rendering and the CARLA map are not modelled
the upstream PreProcessing step (LiDAR column removal, transpose and farthest-point sampling) is not modelled: the fake returns its raw small LiDAR stand-in
the fake reward and termination are test data, not the upstream Reward function (collision, lane invasion, steering/throttle jerk, speed, target and waypoint terms)
the fake draws the scenario and start state with Python's random.Random; upstream draws the scenario with numpy's generator and spawns traffic with the random module, so seeds do not agree
the fake was never compared with a CARLA server; neither the sim backend nor the CARLA engine was run here

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
